question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 11 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 3 cm and 6 cm, respectively. What is the weight (in kg) of the shell?

( {Use } pi = (22)/(7), { Density } = frac{{Mass}}{{Volume}} )
solution:
**Given:**

Density of metal = 11 g/cm³

Internal radius (r₁) = 3 cm

External radius (r₂) = 6 cm

**Formula used:**

Density = Mass / Volume

Volume of a hollow sphere = dfrac{4}{3}pi(r₂³ - r₁³)

Mass(g) = Density(g/cm3) × Volume(cm3)

Weight = Mass × 10⁻³
